qemu_binfmt_entries.description: List of QEMU user-mode binary format registrations to enable.

name.description: A short, unique identifier for this entry (e.g., 'qemu-arm', 'qemu-aarch64').

type.description: Entry type: 'F' (file) or 'M' (magic). 'F' is most common for QEMU.

offset.description: Byte offset in the binary where magic/mask should be applied (usually 0 for 'F' type).

magic.description: Hex string (e.g., '7f454c46') representing the ELF magic bytes. Required for type 'M'.

mask.description: Hex string (e.g., 'ffffff00') used to mask magic bytes before comparison. Required for type 'M'.

interpreter.description: Path to the QEMU user-mode emulator binary (e.g., '/usr/bin/qemu-arm-static', '/usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static').

flags.description: Flags for binfmt registration. Common: 'O' (open), 'C' (close after exec), 'P' (preserve-argv), 'E' (extended semantics). 'OC' is standard.
